description: This file is a test script for validating the handling of empty symbolic links in a Subversion (SVN) repository via git-svn. It sets up an SVN repository, loads dump data with special symlink properties, performs clones with specific configurations, and verifies the correct treatment of symlinks versus empty files across different clones.
